'''''Eurogrip Tyres''''', also known as '''''TVS Tyres''''', is an Indian [[tyre (wheel)|tyre]] brand owned by [[TVS Group]]. It was founded in 1982 and is based in [[Madurai, Tamil Nadu]]. It primarily manufactures tyres for [[two wheeler]], [[three wheeler]], and [[off-road vehicles]].

== History ==
TVS Srichakra was incorporated in 1982 in [[Madurai]] under TVS Mobility Group, a subsidiary of [[TVS Group]].<ref name="auto1">{{cite web |title=Eurogrip Tyres Continues as Technical Partner for PETRONAS TVS India One Make Championship |url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news/eurogrip-tyres-continues-as-technical-partner-for-petronas-tvs-india-one-make-championship-126910 |website=Autocar Professional |language=en}}</ref> It manufactured tyres under the brand "TVS Tyres" for [[two wheeler]], [[three wheeler]], and [[off-road vehicles]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=TVS Eurogrip eyes US business for off-highway tyres, displays latest products at SEMA Show |url=https://www.autocarpro.in/news-international/tvs-eurogrip-eyes-us-business-for-off-highway-tyres-displays-latest-products-at-sema-show-117622 |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=Autocar Professional |language=en}}</ref> In 2018, the company rebranded itself as Eurogrip Tyres.<ref name="auto2">{{cite web |title=TVS’ tyres business re-brands to 'TVS Eurogrip', to focus on exports and after-sales - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/retail/tvs-tyres-business-re-brands-to-tvs-eurogrip-to-focus-on-exports-and-after-sales-4208831.htm |website=CNBCTV18 |access-date=12 May 2026 |language=en |date=20 August 2019}}</ref>

Eurogrip Tyres was the principal sponsor of [[Indian Premier League|IPL]] team [[Chennai Super Kings]] from 2022 to 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TVS Eurogrip signs up for some "yellove", as principle sponsor of CSK for next three years |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tvs-eurogrip-signs-up-for-some-yellove-as-principle-sponsor-of-csk-for-next-three-years-7753841.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230502154736/http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tvs-eurogrip-signs-up-for-some-yellove-as-principle-sponsor-of-csk-for-next-three-years-7753841.html |archive-date=2023-05-02 |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Products ==
The company has manufacturing facilities in [[Madurai, Tamil Nadu]] and [[Rudrapur, Uttarakhand]]. As of June 2025, their combined monthly production capacity was 30 lakh tyres.<ref name="auto1"/> Its flagship tyre range includes Protorq Extreme, Roadhound, and Trailhound series.<ref>{{cite web |title=TVS Eurogrip tyre sizes, price, performance, life - Introduction {{!}} Autocar India |url=https://www.autocarindia.com/auto-features/experiencing-tvs-eurogrip-roadhound-big-bike-tyres-on-track-429080 |website=Autocar |access-date=12 May 2026 |language=en}}</ref> It supplies its tyres to the replacement market and [[original equipment manufacturers]] like [[Bajaj Auto]] and [[Royal Enfield]], and its group firm, [[TVS Motor Company]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dcruze |first1=George |title=TVS Eurogrip intends to be the leading premium 2W tyremaker in India |url=https://www.evoindia.com/news/bike-news/tvs-eurogrip-intends-to-be-the-leading-premium-2w-tyremaker-in-india |website=www.evoindia.com |access-date=12 May 2026 |language=en |date=17 September 2020}}</ref>

According to ''[[Fortune India]]'', it holds a 25% market share{{when|date=April 2026}} in the country's two- and three-wheler tyre segment.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web |title=TVS Srichakra Ltd |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/companies/tvs-srichakra-ltd |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=Fortune India |language=en}}</ref>

In 2018, its parent entered into a partnership with [[Michelin]] to produce the French brand's two-wheeler tyre models in India.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-06-09 |title=TVS Srichakra to make Michelin 2-wheeler tyres |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/tvs-srichakra-to-make-michelin-2-wheeler-tyres/article62309351.ece |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

In 2019, it started operations in [[Milan, Italy]] to cater to European markets. Across its markets in 85 countries,<ref name=":0" /> Eurogrip Tyres sells over 400 products for two-wheelers alone.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TVS Srichakra enters European 2-wheeler tyre market with Eurogrip brand |url=https://www.overdrive.in/news-cars-auto/tvs-srichakra-enters-european-2-wheeler-tyre-market-with-eurogrip-brand/ |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=Overdrive |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=From TVS Tyres To Eurogrip: Leading The Way In Global Tyre Innovation |url=https://www.mobilityoutlook.com/features/from-tvs-tyres-to-eurogrip-leading-the-way-in-global-tyre-innovation/ |access-date=2026-04-25 |website=Mobility Outlook}}</ref>

== Finances ==
TVS Srichakra is publicly listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/india/stockpricequote/tyres/tvssrichakra/TVS03|title=TVS Srichakra|access-date=2026-04-25|website=Money Control}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
TVS Srichakra was part of the [[Fortune India 500]] rankings from 2014 to 2020.<ref name="auto"/>

In 2025, its Protorq Extreme tyre model received the “Tyre of the Year” award at the Motoring World Awards.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Poumai |first1=Keshav Teiva |title=Motoring World Awards 2025: And The Award Goes To… |url=https://motoringworld.in/car-news/news-25/ |website=Motoring World |access-date=12 May 2026 |date=18 January 2025}}</ref>
